basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Central Sunset, 1542 22nd Avenue offers a rare combination of charm, space, and potential. Situated on an expansive 2,996 sq. ft. lot, this exquisite home features a large, flat rear yard perfect for outdoor gatherings, gardening, or creating your own private oasis. The second floor boasts two spacious bedrooms, providing a serene retreat with ample comfort and privacy. Sunlight pours into the bright and airy living room, while the well-proportioned dining room offers an elegant space for entertaining. The generous kitchen presents an excellent opportunity to craft your ideal culinary space. Designed with convenience in mind, the bathroom includes both a bathtub and a separate shower stall, along with a separate toilet room. A sizable garage provides abundant storage, hobby space, and parking, with alley access leading to additional living square footage. With timeless charm, functional living areas, and endless possibilities, this home is a rare find in a prime location close to shops, dining, parks, and easy transportation. Tons of potential, a must see!
